title: Portfolio Manager
leads: The operators on your sites. One operator for every ten phones.
where: On the floor of the sites in your portfolio, moving between them every day
hours: Clock-in at 7:00 AM, wrap report by 6:00 PM, six days a week
summary: You own a group of sites and the hours they record every month.

posting.headline: Portfolio Manager (site operations), Cairo
posting.about: We run video recording teams at factories, warehouses, farms, and construction sites across Cairo. Workers wear a small camera on a cap while they do their normal job. A Portfolio Manager owns a group of sites and the hours they record each month: the operators, the phones, the flags, and the daily report. You work on the floor, and you start with two weeks as an operator.
do: Run your operators: rotations, the 30-minute cycle, restarts, charging, and phone custody.
Visit every site without warning, at least once a day.
Answer every quality flag within 24 hours. The worker gets the fix the same day.
Handle absences and no-shows. You are the first response to any problem on the floor.
Review the day's footage at 5:00 PM. Send the wrap report by 6:00 PM.
Screen every new worker before a phone goes on them.
Run launch day with the Head of Deployment, and look for new sites.
need: Ready to spend two weeks as an operator first.
Able to lead a small team and give a correction calmly, in person.
On your feet, moving between sites, six days a week.
Careful with numbers and on time with a report, every day.
plus: You have been an operator on one of our sites.
You have led a team on a factory, warehouse, or construction floor.
offer: A steady monthly wage, paid on time.
Paid training: two weeks as an operator, then one week beside a Portfolio Manager.
Your own portfolio of sites and a clear monthly target.
A referral reward when a site you found signs.
posting.apply: Send your name, age, where you live, a phone number, and where you have worked. We call back within two working days.

offer.heading: Offer of employment
paragraphs: We are pleased to offer you the position of Portfolio Manager at KMSC. You will report to {manager}, the Director of Operations.
Your start date is {start}. Your first two weeks are paid training as an operator. Then one week with {manager} and a Portfolio Manager, before you take your own sites.

terms.label: Place of work
terms.v: Based at {site}, moving between the sites in your portfolio

terms.label: Hours
terms.v: Clock-in at 7:00 AM, wrap report by 6:00 PM, six days a week

terms.label: Pay
terms.v: {pay} per month, paid at the end of the month

conditions: A copy of your national ID.
Your signature on the rules, the consent form, and the fraud briefing.
One account in your own name. Accounts are never shared.
expect: You are on a site at 7:00 AM every working day.
Your wrap report is in by 6:00 PM. Every flag is answered within 24 hours.
Every phone in your portfolio is counted, morning and evening.
offer.closing: Please sign below to accept this offer. We look forward to working with you.

handbook.purpose: The client pays for accepted hours. Your portfolio has a monthly target. Those hours come from operators who show up, phones that are counted, and workers who hear about a flag in time. You own all three, and nothing on your floors waits for someone else.
outcomes: Your portfolio reaches its monthly hour target.
Every flag on your sites is closed within 24 hours, and the fix holds.
Every phone is counted morning and evening. Mano has your wrap report by 6:00 PM.
daily: 7:00 AM. Clock in with your operators. A phone missing now is your call at 7:05.
During the shift. Visit every site without warning. Angles, restarts, charging, who has which phone.
A flag lands. Tell Moharam within the hour. Show the worker the video and say the fix.
Any hour. Absence, broken phone, site below target: fix it or call Moharam within the hour.
4:00 PM. Take the handover and match the morning count.
5:00 PM. Watch every session. Delete what must not go out. 6:00 PM. Wrap report to Mano.
8:00 PM. You know who is absent tomorrow and who covers.
weekly: Thursday, 4:00 PM. The three-way count: registry, MDM, and room say the same number.
Once a week. Your portfolio is checked against its target. Bring the cause and the fix.
monthly: Go through the month's flags with each operator. Look for the next site for your portfolio.
standards: A correction is given in person, with the video open. Say what right looks like.
No phone before screening: ID showing 18 or older, signed consent, fraud sign-off, own account.
A phone is on a head, on charge, or in the provided bag, signed for.
Money to Ahmed Alaa, gear to Mano, quality to Youssef Medhat. Nobody contacts the client.
never: Three flags remove a worker the same shift, whatever the site needs.
A phone that goes home, or an account that is shared, ends the job.
Saying the client's name to anyone outside the company ends the job.

firstMonth.what: An operator on one of our sites. Ten phones, every round, every count.
With Moharam and a Portfolio Manager. A real wrap report, one flag closed, one worker screened.
Your own sites. Two wrap reports accepted in a row, and Moharam signs your training.

measures: Accepted hours in your portfolio, against the monthly target.
Flags closed within 24 hours, per week.
The Thursday count: every difference explained the same day.
Wrap reports in by 6:00 PM, every day.
handbook.call: Moharam, for anything on the floor. Mano for gear, Ahmed Alaa for money, Youssef Medhat for a flag. An injury or the police: Moharam, then Adham.
